section: Iterate — change: Papier & Tanne theme and fonts (redesign part 1)
title: Adopt the Papier & Tanne design tokens with self-hosted fonts
context: The app used the default shadcn look. Claude Design produced the Papier & Tanne system (paper surfaces, fir green, Newsreader + Instrument Sans). index.html also loaded a leftover third-party script (cdn.gpteng.co) the privacy text did not mention.
decision: Replace theme tokens (HSL channels; rgba tokens as var()), restyle ui primitives keeping all APIs, share field classes, bundle fonts via @fontsource, remove the gpteng script. Guard tests pin tokens, no external hosts and visible focus.
consequences: Privacy statement now true: no third-party script/style/font. +~100 KB woff2 served from own /assets. Theme menu labels, page layouts and caller colour utilities follow in parts 2/3. Checkbox border token is below 3:1 contrast (design decision pending).
rationale: All reviewers (internal plan, internal + external architecture) recommended self-hosting over Bunny Fonts; user agreed 2026-10-22. HSL channels keep Tailwind opacity modifiers working.
rejected: Bunny Fonts stylesheet (extra outside host, privacy-text duty, CSS-injection surface, test dependency); hex tokens (break opacity modifiers); system fonts only (loses the design's identity).
